original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚青少年因持假枪抢劫被判四年监禁
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 一名尼日利亚青少年Fawaz Oyedeji因在英国持仿制枪械企图劫车，被判处四年监禁。伦敦内区刑事法院依据手机数据和监控录像将其定罪。这名19岁男子假扮购车者，试图用仿制枪抢走一辆价值7万英镑的保时捷卡宴。目前该报道为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚青少年Fawaz Oyedeji因在英国持仿制枪械企图劫车被判处四年监禁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A Nigerian teenager, Fawaz Oyedeji, has been sentenced to four years in prison for attempting to steal a car at gunpoint in the United Kingdom.

key_facts.fact: 伦敦内区刑事法院依据手机数据和监控录像将其定罪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Oyedeji was sentenced at Inner London Crown Court after Met Detectives linked him to the robbery through mobile phone data and CCTV footage.

key_facts.fact: 这名19岁男子假扮购车者，试图用仿制枪抢走一辆价值7万英镑的保时捷卡宴
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the 19-year-old posed as a potential car buyer to steal a £70,000 Porsche Cayenne using an imitation firearm
